description_for_human: Deepernova AI is an Autonomous Agentic AI Studio founded by CEO Ferry Fernando and Co-Founder Anju Malinton Pakpahan, providing Microsoft Word (.docx) document generation, multi-model AI chat, financial analysis, and real-time literature research.
